title: This town has been on fire since 1962

slides.text: THIS TOWN HAS BEEN ON FIRE SINCE 1962
Centralia, Pennsylvania. A coal mining town of more than 1,000 people.
May 1962. A fire is lit at the town dump, inside an old strip mine pit. It reaches a coal seam underground.
They tried to put it out. It kept spreading through the old mines under the town.
Smoke poured out of cracks in the ground. Gas levels in some basements became dangerous.
In 1981, the ground opened under a 12-year-old boy's feet. He grabbed a tree root and was pulled out alive.
The government paid people to leave. Most houses were torn down. In 1992 the state took over the town.
The old highway cracked open from the heat. The town is said to have inspired the movie Silent Hill.
Only a handful of residents remain. Experts say the fire could burn for another 250 years.
